qa.title: Q809 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: Do Onmyoji spells, such as Shikigami Summons, count twice towards this follower's ability?
qa.answer: No. Each card counts only once, even if it's a spell with the Onmyoji trait.

qa.title: Q820 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower's second Fanfare ability triggers, and I have no copies of Whitefrost Whisper in my deck, do I still have to search my deck?
qa.answer: Yes. After looking through your deck, you would shuffle it without adding a Whitefrost Whisper to your EX area.

qa.title: Q819 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: I select an enemy follower with this follower's first Fanfare ability, and then steal that enemy follower with an Angel of Chaos's activated ability. If it's engaged at the start of my next turn, does "It doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase" apply to me?
qa.answer: No. It applies to the controller at the time the ability was played. In this case, because this follower's Fanfare ability was played before you became the stolen follower's controller, it refreshes as normal during your next start phase.

qa.title: Q818 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I select an engaged enemy follower with this follower's first Fanfare ability, will it refresh at the start of its controller's next turn?
qa.answer: No. Although the Fanfare ability's "engage it" effect will not apply to a follower that is already engaged, the "It doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase" will still apply.

qa.title: Q837 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower and 4 One-Tailed Foxes are on my field, and all of my One-Tailed Foxes are destroyed by an ability, does this follower gain +4 attack?
qa.answer: Yes. This follower's "Whenever a Yokai follower you control leaves the field, give this follower +1 attack" will take effect for each One-Tailed Fox that is destroyed.

qa.title: Q836 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: When does this follower's "if a Yokai follower on your field would deal damage, it deals that much plus 1 instead" ability take effect?
qa.answer: It takes effect when a Yokai follower on your field deals attack or combat damage, or damage via abilities. Note that when a follower with 0 or less attack deals attack or combat damage, no damage is dealt at all (it doesn't count as dealing damage).

qa.title: Q835 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower is on my field, and I attack an enemy leader with a 0-attack One-Tailed Fox, does it deal 1 damage?
qa.answer: No. When a follower with 0 or less attack deals attack or combat damage, it doesn't count as dealing damage, and this follower's "if a Yokai follower on your field would deal damage, it deals that much plus 1 instead" only takes effect when damage is dealt.

qa.title: Q834 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have this follower on the field and it has 6 attack. If I attack the enemy leader, and they play Realm of Repose's activated ability with Quick, how much damage does the enemy leader take?
qa.answer:
They take either 4 damage or 5 damage. When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated as follows:

The enemy leader takes 4 damage because they decide to apply this follower's ability to increase the damage dealt by 1 first, so this follower will deal 7 damage before Realm of Repose's ability reduces the damage dealt to their leader to 4.

The enemy leader takes 5 damage because they decide to apply Realm of Repose's ability first, so this follower will deal 6 damage before Realm of Repose's ability reduces the damage to their leader to 4. Then, this follower's ability increases the damage dealt by 1 will take effect so this follower will deal 5 damage.

qa.title: Q833 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower is on my field, and I attack an enemy Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form with a 1-attack One-Tailed Fox, how much damage does Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form take?
qa.answer:
It takes either 0 damage or 1 damage. When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated as follows:

Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form takes 1 damage because its controller decides to apply the follower's ability to increase the damage dealt by 1 first, so the One-Tailed Fox will deal 2 damage before Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form's ability reduces the damage dealt by 1.

Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form takes 0 damage because its controller decides to apply Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form's ability to reduce damage dealt by 1 first, so the One-Tailed Fox will deal 0 damage before this follower's ability increases the damage dealt by 1. However, this follower's "if a Yokai follower on your field would deal damage, it deals that much plus 1 instead" only takes effect when damage is dealt, and 0 damage does not count as dealing damage. So, the ability does not take effect and the damage taken by Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form remains 0.

qa.title: Q832 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If this follower is on my field, and I attack an enemy Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form with a 3-attack Kasha, how much damage does Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form take?
qa.answer:
It takes 3 damage. When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order the abilities are applied.

In this case, whether this follower's ability increases the damage dealt by 1 first, or Lævateinn Dragon, Defense Form's ability reduces damage dealt by 1 first, the damage taken is 3.

qa.title: Q829 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have 2 copies of this follower on my field, does each Yokai follower I play cost 4 less?
qa.answer: Yes. Each copy's "any Yokai follower you play costs 2 less" will trigger.

faces.name: Karula, Arts Master
faces.text: At the start of your end phase, recover 2 play points. Then, if you have at least 2 play points, deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. If you have at least 4, draw a card. If you have at least 6, select up to 1 enemy follower on the field and destroy it.
faces.raw_text: At the start of your end phase, recover 2 play points. Then, if you have at least 2 play points, deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. If you have at least 4, draw a card. If you have at least 6, select up to 1 enemy follower on the field and destroy it.

qa.title: Q878 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: At the start of my end phase, if I have 4 remaining play points, can I recover 2 play points and draw a card before selecting a follower to destroy?
qa.answer: No. When an ability requires a selection, the selection must be made before you resolve the other effects in written order. In this case, before you draw a card or recover 2 play points, you must select an enemy follower (you may also select no enemy followers).

qa.title: Q862 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If I have multiple cards with an "At the start of your end phase" ability triggering, in what order do I resolve them?
qa.answer: You can resolve them in any order. When you proceed to your end phase, all "At the start of your end phase" abilities are triggered and become pending. Then, you can choose the order in which you resolve the pending abilities.

qa.title: Q852 (Aug. 8, 2024)
qa.question: I have this follower and a Deux Ex Machina on my field, and I have 0 remaining play points. At the start of my end phase, can I choose to resolve Deus Ex Machina's "recover 4 play points" ability first before resolving this follower's "recover 2 play points" so I have enough remaining play points to trigger this follower's "deal 2 damage to each enemy leader," "draw a card," and "select up to 1 enemy follower on the field and destroy it" effects?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. Note that your remaining play points can't exceed your maximum play points.
